subject.title: Security: harden gateway timeouts and auth store sealing

question: Should credential-at-rest encryption be redesigned for the current SQLite auth-profile store and OpenClaw key-management model before this PR continues?
rationale: The remaining blockers are not routine patch fixes: they decide key management, downgrade behavior, active storage ownership, migration/recovery policy, and the security boundary for credentials at rest.

options.title: Redesign before merge
options.body: Rebase onto current main and move sealing into the active SQLite/credential migration design with secops review and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split timeout-only work
options.body: If maintainers only want the GatewayClient timeout fix, close or supersede this branch because current main already contains a safer package-level implementation.

options.title: Pause for canonical issue
options.body: Keep or close this PR in favor of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43794 until maintainers settle the credential-encryption direction.

recommendation.title: Redesign before merge
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and move sealing into the active SQLite/credential migration design with secops review and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This maintainer owns the PR, is listed for Security and Agents, and is best positioned to decide whether to sponsor the redesign or retire the branch.
